notes.direction_read_rationale: Near coin-flip with a modest positive tilt resting on positioning, not fundamentals. Long side: 52-week low, -13.1% in 20 sessions vs KWEB -8.4%, -50.5% from the January high, regulatory overhang formally resolved and not appealed, US$6.7bn net cash with ~$4bn of a $5bn buyback unspent, ~9x FY2027 on one analyst's math, implied 7.0% below the 8.20% six-quarter realised mean, and the Q2 2025 analogue printed +14.92% from a similar setup. Short side: the remedies are a permanent take-rate reset that this print is the first to quantify, EBITDA margin already 30% vs 33% a year ago with marketing +24%, China RevPAR -6% in July into the Q3 guide, HSBC cut to Hold at $48 on exactly this, and the last two prints were -2.59% and -12.55%. Magnitude conviction is much higher than direction conviction.
